notes.title: SudokuRPG trading cards and point items are now open!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39348278/25bae9fe0ac8dd6f6804f5a179fd13eb32980034.png[/img]
Thanks to your support and interest, Sudoku RPG has opened new trading cards and point items...! ːsteamthumbsupː

Enjoy the game and collect various fairy cards~!

For those who have already purchased and played the game, the cards will be added to your inventory just by logging in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39348278/a25df83444c9fe22452300f8751dd9626852edd6.png[/img]
Stickers and emoticons are also available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39348278/137e7c37708092cf1bf3f0acff27827e30f1b9c8.png[/img]
Embark on a new journey to earn the Sudoku Master badge.

Thank you for playing our game, and we will continue to work hard to develop even better games.

Have a great day today. ːsWinkː

notes.title: SudokuRPG 1.2.1 Ranking Mode Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39348278/0811c877ba6d2db5365fcc78a2ed68056b8b1631.png[/img]

SudokuRPG 1.2.1 update completed.

Your adventure begins now! Why?
This update has added a ranking mode where all users around the world compete for their skills! Hooray!

A person who solves puzzles with 5 difficulty levels accurately and quickly can be the king of Sudoku.
Try it now!


Updates for better games will continue in the future.

1. Support for Chinese
2. Improve play

notes.title: SudokuRPG 1.1.1 New Mode Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39348278/d3d8b8f6ab8178923e0f3e32f396fc9c9f0b658f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39348278/8e72c35ceadc65721d657319aa5c596a3427fc36.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39348278/7eb76b7ad427887b7c92eef98fc9c9692263908f.png[/img]

Sudoku RPG 1.1.1 update completed.

Classic Sudoku Mode has been added for those who like relaxed and static Sudoku! Hooray!
Classic Sudoku mode can be played by dividing the difficulty level into six levels, and the elapsed time and number of mistakes are recorded to improve the clear speed and accuracy in a short period of time.

Faster! More accurately!


Updates for better games will continue in the future.

Future updates to be made
1. Support for Chinese
2. Add ranking competition mode through Steam Leaderboard


Today is another fun sudoku time~!

notes.title: Sudoku RPG has been successfully released!
